blueprint.title: Audit of claimed 65% efficiency cyclic heat engine between 600 K and 300 K
blueprint.falsifiable_hypothesis: A cyclic heat engine operating between a hot reservoir at 600 K and a cold reservoir at 300 K can attain efficiency eta >= 0.65 while obeying Qin=W+Qout, eta=W/Qin, Qin in [1,200] J, W and Qout nonnegative and at most 200 J, and the Clausius inequality Qout/300 >= Qin/600.
blueprint.research_prompt: Audit, rather than repair, the following falsifiable research claim in a single computational study: a cyclic heat engine operating between a hot reservoir at 600 K and a cold reservoir at 300 K can have efficiency eta >= 0.65 while obeying both thermodynamic laws. Take positive heat input Qin between 1 and 200 J per cycle, work W and rejected heat Qout nonnegative and at most 200 J, and eta in [0,1]. Use Qin=W+Qout, eta=W/Qin and the Clausius inequality Qout/300 >= Qin/600; the reversible Carnot engine provides the ceiling benchmark. Retain eta >= 0.65 as the claim being tested, even if false. Seek a justified refutation with a checkable proof, not a redesigned engine, a weakened target, or a failed-search claim. State SI units explicitly and keep all original bounds sealed.
blueprint.code_template:
import math

def simulation_step(buf, dt):
    t = buf.data[0]
    th = buf.data[1]
    tc = buf.data[2]
    qmin = buf.data[3]
    qmax = buf.data[4]
    eta_claim = buf.data[5]

    carnot = 1.0 - tc / th
    clausius_limit = 1.0 - tc / th
    buf.data[6] = carnot
    buf.data[7] = clausius_limit

    max_feasible = clausius_limit
    feasible_count = 0.0
    n_samples = 100
    last_q = qmin
    last_w = 0.0
    last_qout = 0.0
    last_eta = 0.0
    residual = 0.0

    for k in range(n_samples):
        q = qmin + (qmax - qmin) * k / (n_samples - 1)
        w = eta_claim * q
        qout = q - w
        eta = w / q
        if eta <= clausius_limit + 1e-12:
            feasible_count = feasible_count + 1.0
        last_q = q
        last_w = w
        last_qout = qout
        last_eta = eta
        residual = qout / tc - q / th

    buf.data[8] = max_feasible
    buf.data[9] = eta_claim - max_feasible
    buf.data[10] = feasible_count
    buf.data[11] = last_q
    buf.data[12] = last_w
    buf.data[13] = last_qout
    buf.data[14] = last_eta
    buf.data[15] = residual
    buf.data[0] = t + dt
stage_objectives: Establish the Carnot and Clausius efficiency ceiling for reservoirs at 600 K and 300 K.
Sweep the sealed Qin range 1-200 J to test the retained eta>=0.65 claim against first-law and second-law constraints.
Consolidate the refutation proof by confirming zero feasible samples and a positive violation margin.
